summary:
Worked all 8 results inbox items plus 5 that arrived during the session (RBC-INBOX-01 §8). One item is deliberately left open.

Original items:
- pt-0006 Patel, CT urogram 10-19: no cause for hematuria found; incidental 4 mm LLL nodule is already followed in lung screening. First ordered the annual LDCT on the 12-month schedule. Later revised (see arrivals).
- pt-0016 TSH 2.1: normal, closed. pt-0016 K: corrected from 6.3 to 4.4 (analyzer error). Acted on the corrected value: normal, closed.
- pt-0007 CTA chest, preliminary: final report dr-00084 found no PE and no nodule (the "nodule" is a vessel), with no follow-up needed under RBC-RAD-05. Closed.
- pt-0007 BMP 10-22: creatinine 1.64 vs 0.98 within 48 h = AKI. Ordered an urgent repeat BMP by Mon 10-26 (sr-t0009), sent an urgent patient message, wrote a note. Naproxen PRN (mr-00088) is still active; please consider holding it.
- pt-0064 BMP 09-26, creatinine 1.36: no earlier creatinine within 7 days, so no AKI. Closed.
- pt-0033 BMP 10-22, creatinine 1.31: the 0.84 result is entered in error and was excluded. Compared with 1.27 on 10-17: no AKI. Closed.
- pt-0008 BMP, K 6.4 flagged hemolyzed: first handled under RBC-LAB-03 §2 (urgent repeat BMP sr-t0015, patient message, note). Later revised (see arrivals).

Arrivals and corrected decisions:
- pt-0008: the lab corrected the result. The hemolysis comment belonged to another patient's specimen, so K 6.4 stands. Changed to §1: stat message to pool-oncall, stat BMP today (sr-t0020), corrected stat message to the patient, note. Reviewed his medications: none raise potassium in a way that is safe to hold (metoprolol kept). sr-t0015 is now superseded.
- pt-0006: Lakeshore sent an addendum to the 04-14 LDCT: new 5 mm RUL nodule, Lung-RADS 3, repeat LDCT in 6 months. That window (09-14 to 11-14) is still open. Ordered LDCT for 10-23 to 11-14 (sr-t0024), tracking task due 11-14 (task-t0025), corrected patient message, note. sr-t0001 and its tracking task are now superseded.
- pt-0064: new creatinine 1.48 vs 0.88 within 48 h = AKI. Urgent repeat BMP by 10-26 (sr-t0031), urgent patient message, note.
- pt-0033: new creatinine 1.78 vs 1.31 within 48 h = AKI. Urgent repeat BMP by 10-26 (sr-t0032), urgent patient message, note.
- pt-0007 chest X-ray (inbox-a0002): preliminary only, no final report yet. Left open per §2(c).

Needs you: I couldn't cancel the 2 superseded orders, so I created tasks asking you to discontinue them: sr-t0015 (pt-0008, task-t0030) and sr-t0001 with its tracking task task-t0002 (pt-0006, task-t0026). The messages queue, which has refill requests waiting since before today, was not in scope and is untouched.

evidence.quote: Revised impression Lung-RADS 3; revised recommendation LDCT in 6 months.
